experiment: Data-volume scaling of six fixed TPC-DS query instances on one ClickHouse node
query_order: Ascending query number during warm-up; seeded shuffle for each measured round
cache_policy: Warm queries and filesystem caches; query-result and query-condition caches disabled; no OS cache eviction
load_policy: Same schema and query files across scales; retain input and source hashes
settling_policy: Wait for five consecutive seconds without merges or mutations, pause merges, then record active parts before warm-up
interference_policy: Pause any Milestone 3 data generator during measured work; record running containers
failure_policy: Persist errors and timeouts by query ID, cancel only timed-out experiment query IDs, and continue later query attempts
summary_policy: Median, min, max, sample standard deviation and CV over successful measured runs; show success and failure counts
measurement_scope: Logical bytes read and Linux query profile I/O counters; host physical disk throughput is not measured by this protocol
